title: Phantom Warning
description: Warns you exactly 3 minutes before Phantoms spawn due to lack of sleep. Includes a hotkey to check your status and a personal record tracker!
body:
# Phantom Warning

Never get caught off guard by Phantoms again! Phantom Warning is a highly focused Quality of Life (QoL) mod that alerts you exactly when you are in danger, while also keeping track of your longest sleepless streaks. 🦇

![Phantom Warning Alert](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/X2FbamUI/images/0b8bd4699d24c281c064ee7ef6ed9aa523af7bff.png)

***

## Core Features

**The 3-Minute Alert**
The mod securely tracks your sleep statistics in the background. If you haven't slept for 3 in-game days, it will display a large, unmissable on-screen warning exactly **3 real-time minutes** before the sun sets and Phantoms start spawning. You'll have just enough time to safely find a bed or prepare your weapons for a fight! ⚔️

![Breaking Your Record](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/X2FbamUI/images/5c3bab1165abe00908e00052386c501743ca832c.png)

**Personal Record Tracker**
Are you trying to survive as long as possible without sleeping? The mod permanently saves your highest consecutive days awake per world. If you surpass your previous limit, it will cheer you on with a special on-screen notification. 🏆

![Checking Phantom Status](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/X2FbamUI/images/0acfd2e63a42a9424a7752c224e958493452a006.png)

**On-Demand Status Check**
Don't remember how many days it's been since you last slept? Simply press the dedicated hotkey to instantly view your current days awake and your all-time personal record directly on the screen. 📊

![Custom Keybind Integration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/X2FbamUI/images/84b575ebdef5ea7dc837619bb2401bfcd39f35ea.png)

**Native Integration**
The status check keybind is fully integrated into the Vanilla controls menu. By default, it is bound to the **N** key, but you can change it to whatever fits your playstyle. ⌨️

***

## Supported Languages

The mod automatically adapts to your client's language settings. It currently supports out of the box:
* English (US)
* Spanish (Spain)
* Portuguese (Brazil)
* Russian
* Italian
* German
* French
* Simplified Chinese
* Japanese
* Arabic
* Korean

***

## Installation Requirements

This mod uses custom networking channels to communicate the hotkey presses to the server logic. Therefore, it is **Required on both Client and Server**. 
* **Singleplayer:** Just drop it in your `mods` folder.
* **Multiplayer:** Both the dedicated server and the connecting players must have the mod installed to avoid network kicks.
